log:
# Change log: Genetics, Genomics & Biobank

## 2026-06-28

Initial build of the Genetics, Genomics & Biobank knowledge base. Ingested all 32 source papers from `benchmark_corpus/03_genetics_genomics_biobank/papers/` into `raw/` via `bokf convert`. Extracted knowledge across 10 thematic clusters (FINDbase allele-frequency databases; UK Biobank plasma proteomics & clonal hematopoiesis; UK Biobank ML target-discovery tools — DrugnomeAI, Gene-SCOUT, Mantis-ML 2.0, MILTON; variant/non-coding prioritization — Variant Ranker, JARVIS/gwRVIS; Mucopolysaccharidosis-Plus Syndrome / VPS33A; epilepsy genetics — Epi25 exome + CNV studies; Mendelian gene discovery — CRELD1, SPDL1, RFC1, UCHL1, SPTAN1, PSC; and association/cohort studies — CARD8, CUBN, ORM1, Mexico City Prospective Study). Consolidated with cross-paper deduplication (28 shared entities merged, e.g. UK Biobank, FINDbase, Type 2 diabetes mellitus, GWAS, whole-exome sequencing). Result: 321 concept documents (32 Publication source nodes + 289 typed concepts) and 822 edges (363 curated claims + 459 reported_in provenance links). `bokf verify` passes with 0 errors; 9 residual source.unanchored warnings on entities lacking a standard external CURIE.

A new, restructured version was released to migrate FINDbase content into 90 individual ETHNOS-based NEGDBs.

FINDbase.body:
# FINDbase

Frequency of INherited Disorders database (FINDbase): a worldwide National/Ethnic Mutation Database (NEMDB) and relational database, established in 2006 and derived from the ETHNOS software, that documents allele frequencies of clinically relevant genomic variation (causative mutations and pharmacogenomic markers) per population/ethnic group; stores only summary-level allele-frequency data to preserve anonymity. By 2014 it comprised three modules (causative mutations, pharmacogenomic biomarkers, genetic disease summaries) and recorded >125000 accesses from >120 countries.

Gene-SCOUT.body:

JARVIS.body:
# JARVIS

'Junk Annotation' RVIS: a multi-module deep-learning framework for pathogenicity inference of non-coding regions. Combines a CNN processing raw 3 kb genomic sequence with a feed-forward DNN over structured features (gwRVIS, GC content, mutability rate, CpG density, histone marks, chromatin accessibility, CTCF sites); softmax output gives a single-nucleotide-resolution pathogenicity likelihood. Naive to phylogenetic conservation.

Kar et al. 2022 — UK Biobank clonal hema.body:
# Kar et al. 2022 — UK Biobank clonal hematopoiesis GWAS

Genome-wide analysis of clonal hematopoiesis (CH) in 200,453 UK Biobank participants using whole-exome sequencing for somatic driver detection and GWAS, increasing germline CH loci from 4 to 14 (TERT, SMC4, CD164, ATM, PARP1, SETBP1, TCL1A, CHEK2, etc.), revealing DNMT3A- vs TET2-CH subtype heterogeneity, and using Mendelian randomization to establish smoking and longer telomere length as causal risk factors and CH as a cause of myeloproliferative neoplasia, solid cancers and atrial fibrillation.

# National and Ethnic Mutation Database

SPTAN1.body:
# SPTAN1

Spectrin alpha non-erythrocytic 1; encodes alpha-II spectrin (alpha-2-spectrin), a 2472-aa cytoskeletal protein with eight spectrin repeats, an SH3 domain, 12 further repeats and 3 EF hands. A core organizer of the submembranous axonal cytoskeleton (forms heterotetramers with beta-spectrins). Extremely intolerant to LoF (RVIS -3.53, top 0.31%; pLI = 1; gnomAD LoF observed 8 vs expected 142.7). Variants cause a wide spectrinopathy spectrum including EIEE5, HSP, ataxia, neuropathy, and distal myopathy.

# SPTAN1-related early childhood onset distal myopathy with neurogenic features

A novel early childhood onset distal myopathy caused by heterozygous SPTAN1 loss-of-function variants. UCHL1-related autosomal dominant neurode.body:
# UCHL1-related autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disorder

An autosomal dominant, late-onset (median 49 y, range 12-70) neurodegenerative disorder caused by heterozygous UCHL1 loss-of-function variants. Core phenotype is a movement disorder with spasticity, cerebellar and/or sensory ataxia, sensorimotor neuropathy, and frequently optic atrophy; milder and later-onset than the recessive SPG79.

gwRVIS.body:
# gwRVIS

Genome-wide residual variation intolerance score: a single-nucleotide-resolution human-lineage constraint score computed by a sliding-window (3 kb) ordinary linear regression of common (MAF>0.1%) on all variants from WGS data; the studentized residual is gwRVIS, with lower values = greater intolerance. Computed over 2.4 billion bp (~75% of genome). Agnostic to evolutionary conservation.

Lower-limb spasticity with brisk deep tendon reflexes; a core feature of the UCHL1 disorder (24/31 individuals) and of SPTAN1-related HSP.

thrombocytopenia.body:
# thrombocytopenia

Low platelet count observed in MPSPS patients; part of the hematopoietic 'Plus' phenotype accompanied by hypoplastic/fatty bone marrow lacking megakaryocytes.

ultraconserved noncoding elements.body:
# ultraconserved noncoding elements

UCNEs: highly conserved non-coding regions (human-chicken); identified by gwRVIS as the most intra-species intolerant genomic class (median gwRVIS -0.99) despite gwRVIS using no conservation information.

van Baal et al. 2007 — FINDbase relation.body:
# van Baal et al. 2007 — FINDbase relational database

Original NAR Database Issue paper introducing FINDbase, a relational database derived from the ETHNOS software recording frequencies of causative mutations leading to inherited disorders worldwide; October 2006 release held 3379 records on 31 disorders, 1223 mutations, 24 genomic regions across 83 populations.
